deploymentNotes: The compatible default Apache profile retains a root master on port 80 and drops workers to www-data. The optional hardened build target runs as www-data on 8080 with deployment-managed code; use its read-only Compose profile after deployment validation. This does not sandbox admitted PHP plugins.
